selected.title: UK banks pilot tokenised deposit transactions
selected.summary: UK banks have collaborated to complete the first live customer transactions using tokenised sterling deposits.
selected.why: UK banks complete first live customer transactions using tokenised sterling deposits.

reason: UK tokenised deposits pilot raises a genuine debate about whether central bank digital currency infrastructure should run through commercial banks or separately.
angle: Bank-led tokenisation may entrench incumbent power rather than democratise financial plumbing as advocates claim.
